h1: Bonito Chinos Hotel Nakhon Sawan — a 4-star boutique downtown, walk to the malls, with a rooftop city-view restaurant
intro: If you're heading to Nakhon Sawan and want a base that's ideal for shopping and eating around town, Bonito Chinos Hotel is a name guests in the Pak Nam Pho area mention often · a 4-star boutique hotel with 76 rooms on Sawanwithi Road, just minutes from V Square and Big C malls and an easy walk to Sawan Park · it has a rooftop restaurant with city views that many guests love, free parking and free breakfast, with rates from approx. ฿650/night.

body.html: The thing that makes Bonito Chinos Hotel such a popular base in Nakhon Sawan is its location · it sits on Sawanwithi Road in downtown Pak Nam Pho, just minutes from V Square and Big C malls, with a 7-Eleven right across the road and Sawan Park, the city's central public park, about a 10-minute walk away · its location category scores around 9.4 out of 10 on booking platforms, the point real reviews praise most.

The hotel itself is a 4-star boutique with 76 rooms that opened around 2011 · the feature guests bring up most is the rooftop restaurant with sweeping views over Nakhon Sawan, a favourite spot for a relaxed evening · downstairs there are dining areas and large meeting rooms for banquets and seminars, which makes it a choice for both travellers and people here on business.

Rooms come as Standard, New Superior, New Deluxe and Suite · all are air-conditioned with a flat-screen TV, a fridge with minibar and a work desk, some with a balcony, and the Suite has a rain shower · the New Superior and New Deluxe rooms are the renovated ones, and guests say they feel a good size with comfortable beds · Wi-Fi is free throughout.

"Great location, you can walk to the malls and restaurants, the staff are polite and helpful, free parking is convenient and the rooftop restaurant has a lovely view — good value for a night in town."

To be honest, the recurring complaint is cleanliness and room condition that isn't consistent across every room · some reviews mention floors or corners that weren't cleaned thoroughly, ageing towels and hot water that isn't strong enough in certain rooms · parts of the building and some furnishings are showing their age, and the renovated rooms are clearly in better shape.

Another thing to know before booking is noise and Wi-Fi during busy periods · some reviews note a loud air-conditioner and Wi-Fi that slows down when the hotel is full or hosting a banquet · parking is free but can fill up when there's an event in the meeting rooms · still, most guests praise the staff as polite and helpful, another category that scores high.

Overall, Bonito Chinos Hotel scores around 8.7 out of 10 from 177 reviews on Trip.com and ranks among the top boutique/inn options in central Nakhon Sawan · it isn't a brand-new luxury property, but measured on its downtown location, the walk to the malls and Sawan Park, the rooftop restaurant, free parking and free breakfast, and rates that start around ฿650 and climb with the season and room type into the mid-thousands — it's a well-balanced choice for staying in the heart of Pak Nam Pho.

A tip from reading the reviews: ask for a renovated New Superior or New Deluxe room for a better condition than the older Standard rooms · if you're sensitive to noise, request a room away from the meeting rooms and the street side · drop by the rooftop restaurant in the evening for the city view, and check the room condition at check-in — if any linens or corners aren't clean, you can ask to have them changed.

honestSummary: Bonito Chinos Hotel is a well-balanced choice for anyone who wants to stay in central Pak Nam Pho, within walking distance of the malls and Sawan Park — a standout location, rooftop city views, free parking and free breakfast, at rates from the hundreds into the mid-thousands of baht · the trade-off is cleanliness that isn't consistent across every room and parts of the building that are starting to age.
honestChecks: If you're particular about cleanliness and room condition — some older Standard rooms have reviews about floors not cleaned thoroughly or ageing linens → ask for a renovated New Superior or New Deluxe room and check the condition at check-in.
If you're a light sleeper — some reviews mention a loud air-conditioner and noise from banquets in the meeting rooms → request a room away from the meeting rooms and the street side.
If you need reliable Wi-Fi for work — the signal slows when the hotel is full → keep a mobile data plan as backup, or work in the lobby or rooftop restaurant where the signal is better.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Bonito Chinos Hotel, Nakhon Sawan

faq.q: Where is Bonito Chinos Hotel in Nakhon Sawan, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Bonito Chinos Hotel is at 314/29 Sawanwithi Road, Pak Nam Pho, in downtown Nakhon Sawan · it's minutes from V Square and Big C malls, with a 7-Eleven across the road · Sawan Park is about a 10-minute walk, and Bung Boraphet is around a 20-minute drive.

faq.q: How much does Bonito Chinos Hotel cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approx. ฿650/night for a Standard room, breakfast included · choices range from Standard, New Superior and New Deluxe up to the Suite with a rain shower · prices climb with the season and room type into the mid-thousands, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does Bonito Chinos Hotel have parking?
faq.a: Yes · free parking with EV charging · note that parking can fill up when the hotel is hosting a banquet or seminar in its meeting rooms, so it helps to arrive early.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Bonito Chinos Hotel — are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are air-conditioned with a flat-screen TV, fridge and minibar, and some have a balcony · cleanliness isn't consistent across every room, with some reviews mentioning floors not cleaned thoroughly or ageing linens · it's worth asking for a renovated New Superior or New Deluxe room and checking the condition at check-in.

faq.q: Does Bonito Chinos Hotel have a restaurant?
faq.a: Yes · there's a rooftop restaurant with views over Nakhon Sawan, a relaxed evening spot guests love, plus free breakfast · the surrounding malls and downtown restaurants are also an easy walk away.

faq.q: Who is Bonito Chinos Hotel best for?
faq.a: It's ideal for anyone who wants to stay in central Pak Nam Pho within walking distance of the malls and Sawan Park — travellers, couples, families and business or seminar guests · it's about location, the rooftop restaurant and free parking at rates starting in the hundreds of baht, rather than brand-new luxury.
